headerDisplay: Connects Honda vehicles from your My Honda+ / Honda Connect Europe account to HomeKit. Tested on the Honda e; other Honda Connect Europe vehicles (e:Ny1, ZR-V, CR-V, Civic, HR-V, Jazz 2020+) may work but are unverified.
footerDisplay: On first run, Honda requires this device to be verified by email. Watch the Homebridge log after saving — it will tell you when to check your inbox and paste the verification link back into this form.

verificationLink.title: Verification Link (first run only)
verificationLink.description: After saving this config for the first time, check the Homebridge log. If Honda needs to verify this device, it will email you a link — paste the full link here (do not click it first), save, and restart Homebridge. You can remove it again afterwards.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Language/country code used for Honda API requests, e.g. en-GB, it-IT, de-DE, fr-FR.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Status Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to fetch fresh vehicle status from Honda. Minimum 60 seconds. This reads Honda's most recently cached data unless "Wake vehicle on every poll" is enabled.

wakeVehicleOnPoll.title: Wake vehicle on every poll
wakeVehicleOnPoll.description: If enabled, every poll asks the car itself for fresh data instead of using Honda's cache. This is slower, can take up to ~90 seconds per vehicle, and drains the 12V battery faster if polled frequently — most users should leave this off.

enableHornSwitch.title: Expose horn & lights ("Find My Car") switch

vehicles.title: Per-Vehicle Overrides
vehicles.description: Optional. Override settings for a specific vehicle by VIN.
